correctness.rationale: Using published support union, a nonidentity x with support containing a has x<=_J a. Conversely a<=_J y forces support(y) subset {a}, so y=1 or a; hence generators are exactly J-coatoms. For a<b, two-letter Knuth/idempotence gives aba=ba=bab, (ab)^2=ba and (ba)^2=ba. Left insertion on the empty column distinguishes ab and ba, so (ab)^2!=ab and (ba)^2=ba; therefore the intrinsic idempotence test (ab)^2=ab iff a>b recovers all pairwise comparisons. Isomorphisms must preserve the only increasing bijection, anti-isomorphisms the only decreasing bijection; existence of anti maps follows from published evacuation. Handles ranks 0 and 1 as trivial; rank-3 independent transformation enumeration recovered 15 elements and J coatoms, without being treated as the unrestricted proof.
